papers.title: How Much Screening Buys a Second? Speed, Selection, and the Maker's Spread
papers.abstract: We study the spread a liquidity provider needs to break even against counterparties that can exploit a stale quote, and we place two defenses on a single scale: repricing sooner and screening informed flow. A break-even condition pins down the exact screening rate at which a slower maker matches a faster unscreened venue: the selection that buys back the extra staleness. The result requires only an integrable price innovation and therefore holds under jumps, atoms, and infinite variance. Predictable drift is a centering problem: it widens a spot-centered quote, but its cost vanishes once the quote is recentered on the expected reference. In four USDC-WETH pools benchmarked against Binance ETH-USDT from June to August 2026, the one-second benchmark innovation is sharply non-Gaussian: 73% of seconds show no price change. Cutting cadence from twelve seconds to one sheds 84.5% of the expected shock, so a twelve-second maker must screen at least 84.5% of informed flow to match a one-second venue, far above the 71.1% that a Gaussian model implies. In trending markets, the stale pool is picked off at execution: with-trend fills obtain an effective spread 11.1 bps lower than against-trend fills, with the same sign in all four pools.
papers.relevance_reason: 量化造市商防範資訊流所需的價差與篩選率，結合真實造市資料，實證扎實且具高度實務價值。

summary.title_zh: 篩選交易流能換取多少時間？速度、選樣與造市商價差
summary.verdict: 分析流動性提供者為抵禦陳舊報價所需的損益平衡價差，量化了更快的更新頻率與篩選知情交易流之間的權衡。
summary.problem: 探討速度較慢的造市商需要多高的篩選率，才能抵銷遭遇陳舊報價被逆向選擇的損失，並匹配速度較快的交易場所。
summary.method: 建構理論模型，並以 2026 年 6 月至 8 月的四個 USDC-WETH 流動性池、對標 Binance ETH-USDT 進行實證分析。
summary.findings: 一秒鐘的價格創新呈現強烈的非高斯分佈，73% 的秒數無價格變動。將報價頻率從十二秒降至一秒可排除 84.5% 的預期衝擊，高於高斯模型推論的 71.1%。在趨勢市場中，順勢成交的有效價差比逆勢成交低 11.1 個基點。
summary.implication: 造市商若無法提升更新頻率，必須依賴極高的知情交易流篩選率來維持損益平衡，這對低頻造市策略的防禦設計有直接指導意義。
summary.caveats: 模型依賴於特定期間的去中心化交易所與中心化交易所的對標資料，且未納入動態交易成本的完整考量。

papers.title: Spurious Predictability in Financial Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Adaptive specification search generates statistically significant backtests even under martingale-difference nulls. We introduce a falsification audit testing complete predictive workflows against synthetic reference classes, including zero-predictability environments and microstructure placebos. Workflows generating significant walk-forward evidence in these environments are falsified. For passing workflows, we quantify selection-induced performance inflation using an absolute magnitude gap linking optimized in-sample evidence to disjoint walk-forward realizations, adjusted for effective multiplicity. Simulations validate extreme-value scaling under correlated searches and demonstrate detection power under genuine structure. Empirical case studies confirm that many apparent findings represent methodological artifacts rather than genuine predictability.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 10 figures. The QuantAudit R package and full replication scripts will be made publicly available upon journal publication
papers.relevance_reason: 探討金融機器學習中的偽預測性並提供檢驗框架，方法嚴謹且具重大實務警示意義。

summary.title_zh: 金融機器學習中的偽預測性
summary.verdict: 提出偽造稽核來檢測機器學習回測中的虛假預測，量化過擬合帶來的績效膨脹。

summary.method: 引入 falsification audit，將完整的預測工作流程與合成參考類別進行測試，包含零預測環境與微結構安慰劑。使用模擬與實證案例研究進行驗證。

papers.title: Diversification Across Predictors: Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning for Cross-Sectional Return Prediction
papers.abstract: Cross-sectional stock return prediction remains challenging due to extremely low signal-to-noise ratios, high-dimensional factor spaces, and non-stationary predictor effectiveness. Individual model classes exhibit complementary failure modes in this regime: neural networks overfit noise due to high variance, while linear models underfit nonlinear structure due to high bias. We propose a heterogeneous ensemble framework that extends the financial principle of diversification to the predictor level. Through a bagging procedure combining linear predictors with nonlinear predictors, each model functions as a distinct specialist whose prediction errors exhibit low cross-covariance, enabling error cancellation upon aggregation. We formalize this mechanism via bias-variance-covariance decomposition, establishing an exact mathematical correspondence between portfolio diversification and predictor aggregation. On CSI300 daily-frequency Alpha158 factor datasets, the proposed ensemble achieves a Rank IC improvement exceeding 13\% over standalone neural networks and surpasses tree-based state-of-the-art methods including XGBoost and Double Ensemble, as measured by both predictive accuracy and portfolio-based evaluation metrics.
papers.relevance_reason: 提出異質整合學習預測報酬，在中國股市因子資料集上驗證，已被 ICAIF 接受。

summary.title_zh: 預測變數的多元化：應用於橫截面報酬預測的異質集成學習
summary.verdict: 提出結合線性與非線性模型的異質集成框架，利用錯誤協方差抵消來提升橫截面報酬預測效能。
summary.problem: 橫截面股票報酬預測面臨極低訊號雜訊比、高維度因子空間與預測變數效能非平穩的挑戰。單一模型類別在此體制下各有缺陷，例如類神經網路過擬合雜訊，線性模型則欠擬合非線性結構。
summary.method: 結合線性與非線性預測變數的裝袋程序（bagging），資料使用 CSI300 日頻 Alpha158 因子資料集，透過偏差-變異數-協方差分解進行理論形式化。
summary.findings: 所提出的集成方法在 Rank IC 上相較於單獨的類神經網路實現了超過 13% 的改善，並在預測準確度與投資組合評估指標上超越了 XGBoost 與 Double Ensemble 等樹狀模型最新方法。
summary.implication: 此方法將投資組合多元化原理延伸至預測變數層級，實務上可直接透過集成具備低交叉協方差的異質模型來降低預測誤差。
summary.caveats: 未詳細說明在扣除真實交易成本後的具體投資組合淨績效。

papers.title: Diversified-Risk-Perception Risk Measures and Portfolio Selection
papers.abstract: Traditional risk measures generally rely on a single probability model, potentially overlooking information from alternative models and leading to biased risk assessments. This limitation cannot be addressed by asset diversification alone in risk management. In this paper, we propose a Diversified-Risk-Perception (DRP) risk measure framework that integrates asset diversification and risk model diversification to provide a more comprehensive assessment of market risk while reducing reliance on any single model. First, we introduce a flexible exponential aggregation function to evaluate the risk of a portfolio, which accounts for the contributions of all loss components while placing greater emphasis on large losses. Second, we incorporate multiple risk models in the risk measure and optimize their weights based on their perceptions on the risk assessments. As a specific example, we introduce DRP expected shortfall (DRP-ES), establish its theoretical properties, and derive bounds quantifying its sensitivity to model parameters. Empirical experiments in the U.S., Chinese A-share, and South Korean stock markets show that trading strategies based on the DRP-ES achieve higher Sharpe ratios and lower maximum drawdowns than market benchmarks across different periods. Compared with asset diversification strategies based on individual probability models, the DRP strategy exhibits more stable and robust performance across different markets and periods. These findings suggest that the DRP framework can adapt to changing market conditions and improve the stability and effectiveness of portfolio risk management.
papers.relevance_reason: 跨多國市場進行實證，夏普值較基準提升且回撤較低，實證完整。

summary.title_zh: 多元風險感知的風險衡量與投資組合選股
summary.verdict: 提出結合資產與風險模型多元化的 DRP 框架，在美、中、韓股市實證中展現較佳的 Sharpe 比率與穩健性。
summary.problem: 傳統風險衡量依賴單一機率模型而易產生偏差，且單靠資產分散無法解決此問題。
summary.method: 建構包含指數聚合函數與多模型權重最佳化的多元風險感知（DRP）架構，推導 DRP-ES 的理論性質與敏感度邊界。實證涵蓋美國、中國 A 股與南韓股市的跨期表現。
summary.findings: 基於 DRP-ES 的交易策略在不同時期皆實現了較高的 Sharpe 比率與較低的 máxima drawdown（最大回檔），且較單一機率模型更為穩健，論文未報告具體的數值提升幅度。
summary.implication: 可用於改善投資組合的風險管理，提升對市場體制轉換的適應能力，前提是需要估計多個風險模型的權重。
summary.caveats: 模型依賴多重機率模型的聚合與權重最佳化，未明確探討計算複雜度與交易成本的影響。

papers.title: ARTEMIS: A Neuro Symbolic Framework for Economically Constrained Market Dynamics
papers.abstract: Deep learning models in quantitative finance often operate as black boxes, lacking interpretability and failing to incorporate fundamental economic principles such as no-arbitrage constraints. This paper introduces ARTEMIS (Arbitrage-free Representation Through Economic Models and Interpretable Symbolics), a novel neuro-symbolic framework combining a continuous-time Laplace Neural Operator encoder, a neural stochastic differential equation regularised by physics-informed losses, and a differentiable symbolic bottleneck that distils interpretable trading rules. The model enforces economic plausibility via two novel regularisation terms: a Feynman-Kac PDE residual penalising local no-arbitrage violations, and a market price of risk penalty bounding the instantaneous Sharpe ratio. We evaluate ARTEMIS against six strong baselines on four datasets: Jane Street, Optiver, Time-IMM, and DSLOB (a synthetic crash regime). Results demonstrate ARTEMIS achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy, outperforming all baselines on DSLOB (64.96%) and Time-IMM (96.0%). A comprehensive ablation study confirms each component's contribution: removing the PDE loss reduces directional accuracy from 64.89% to 50.32%. Underperformance on Optiver is attributed to its long sequence length and volatility-focused target. By providing interpretable, economically grounded predictions, ARTEMIS bridges the gap between deep learning's power and the transparency demanded in quantitative finance.

summary.title_zh: ARTEMIS：受經濟約束之市場動態的神經符號學框架
summary.verdict: 結合神經網路與符號學的框架，藉由強制無套利與 Sharpe 限制提升預測準確度與可解釋性。
summary.problem: 深度學習模型在量化金融中常作為黑盒子運作，缺乏可解釋性且未能納入無套利等基本經濟原則。

summary.caveats: 在 Optiver 資料集上表現不佳，歸因於其長序列長度與波動率為焦點的目標。

papers.title: Continuous Program Search
papers.abstract: Genetic Programming yields interpretable programs, but small syntactic mutations can induce large, unpredictable behavioral shifts, degrading locality and sample efficiency. We frame this as an operator-design problem: learn a continuous program space where latent distance has behavioral meaning, then design mutation operators that exploit this structure without changing the evolutionary optimizer. We make locality measurable by tracking action-level divergence under controlled latent perturbations, identifying an empirical trust region for behavior-local continuous variation. Using a compact trading-strategy DSL with four semantic components (long/short entry and exit), we learn a matching block-factorized embedding and compare isotropic Gaussian mutation over the full latent space to geometry-compiled mutation that restricts updates to semantically paired entry--exit subspaces and proposes directions using a learned flow-based model trained on logged mutation outcomes. Under identical $(μ+λ)$ evolution strategies and fixed evaluation budgets across five assets, the learned mutation operator discovers strong strategies using an order of magnitude fewer evaluations and achieves the highest median out-of-sample Sharpe ratio. Although isotropic mutation occasionally attains higher peak performance, geometry-compiled mutation yields faster, more reliable progress, demonstrating that semantically aligned mutation can substantially improve search efficiency without modifying the underlying evolutionary algorithm.
papers.relevance_reason: 學習連續程式空間來改善基因程式交易策略搜尋效率，實證扎實

summary.verdict: 透過學習具行為意義的連續潛在空間與幾何編譯變異算子，大幅提升遺傳程式設計的搜尋效率與樣本利用率。
summary.problem: 傳統遺傳程式設計的語法突變會導致難以預測的行為劇烈變動，缺乏局部性與樣本效率。

summary.findings: 幾何編譯變異算子以少了一個數量級的評估次數發現強健策略，並達成最高的樣本外夏普值中位數，且展現更快速可靠的演化進展。

papers.title: Risk-Based Auto-Deleveraging
papers.abstract: Auto-deleveraging (ADL) mechanisms are a critical yet understudied component of risk management on cryptocurrency futures exchanges. When available margin and other loss-absorbing resources are insufficient to cover losses following large price moves, exchanges reduce positions and socialize losses among solvent participants via rule-based ADL protocols. We formulate ADL as an optimization problem that minimizes the exchange's risk of loss arising from future equity shortfalls. In a single-asset, isolated-margin setting, the \emph{minimax leverage} policy -- minimizing the maximum leverage among participants -- is optimal for all monotone risk measures. This policy has a transparent structure: positions are reduced first for the most highly levered accounts, and leverage is progressively equalized via a water-filling (or ``leverage-draining'') rule. The policy is distribution-free, wash-trade resistant, Sybil resistant, and path-independent. It provides a canonical and implementable benchmark for ADL design and clarifies the economic logic underlying queue-based mechanisms used in practice. We further study the multi-asset, cross-margin setting, where the ADL problem becomes genuinely multi-dimensional: the exchange must allocate reductions across accounts with portfolios exposed to correlated price moves. Under the expected loss objective, asset-level shadow prices separate the problem across accounts, yielding a scalable numerical method. Naive gross leverage misleads here, ignoring within-portfolio hedging. When prices are driven by a single risk factor, the optimal policy is again water-filling, but in a factor-adjusted leverage, so better-hedged portfolios are deleveraged less. We apply the framework to the October~10, 2025 Hyperliquid ADL event. Relative to the exchange's realized allocation, our risk-minimizing allocations achieve lower expected shortfall.

summary.title_zh: 基於風險的自動減倉機制

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Modeling for Stochastic Discount Factor Portfolios
papers.abstract: In this work, we study portfolio optimization under the stochastic discount factor (SDF) framework by learning market state representations that capture the underlying risk structures of financial data. This is challenging due to several factors: financial markets exhibit non-stationary dynamics with shifting regimes, multimodal inputs such as price and news data often contain stochastic noise, and existing diffusion-based approaches, while effective for modeling stochastic dynamics, rely on assumptions such as isotropic Gaussian noise that fail to capture the state-dependent nature of financial uncertainty. To address these challenges, we introduce RADAR, a retrieval-augmented diffusion framework that learns market representations by conditioning on similar historical regimes. RADAR leverages retrieval to construct context-dependent noise distributions, applies conditional diffusion to denoise multimodal representations, and initializes the diffusion process using empirical statistics to reflect state-dependent uncertainty. Experiments show that RADAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on key risk-adjusted metrics while producing economically meaningful signals on asset returns and correlations.

papers.title: Decision-Focused Learning for Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization via KKT-Based Reformulation
papers.abstract: Mean-variance portfolio optimization (MVO) is a central framework in data-driven asset management. A widely adopted approach is a two-stage framework that first predicts expected returns and then solves the optimization problem based on these predictions, with the predictive models trained by minimizing prediction errors. However, this objective of prediction is not aligned with the quality of the downstream portfolio decision. Decision-focused learning (DFL), which directly minimizes the downstream decision loss within the learning process, has thus emerged as a promising direction. However, existing DFL approaches to MVO rely on surrogate losses or constraint relaxations for tractability, creating a structural mismatch between predictive model training and the constrained MVO solved at evaluation. We propose a single-level optimization formulation that incorporates the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality conditions of the lower-level MVO into the upper-level learning problem. This formulation explicitly preserves the budget and short-sale constraints while remaining tractable for standard nonlinear optimization solvers. Rolling-window experiments on real-world ETF (Exchange Traded Funds) data across two asset universes with different correlation structures show that our method achieved the best performance on multiple investment metrics and also demonstrated performance improvement due to the proposed regularization.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at PRICAI 2026 (Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence)

summary.problem: 傳統兩階段框架先預測預期報酬再求解投資組合，其預測誤差最小化目標與下游投資組合決策品質不一致。現有方法依賴代理損失或限制放寬，造成訓練與評估間的結構性錯配。
summary.method: 運用單層最佳化公式，將底層均異變異數投資組合的 Karush-Kuhn-Tucker 最佳性條件納入上層學習問題。使用真實世界 ETF 資料進行滾動視窗實驗，涵蓋兩種不同相關性結構的資產投資組合。
summary.findings: 在多項投資指標上達成最佳表現，且透過提出的正規化方法展現出績效提升，論文未報告具體的數值指標。
summary.implication: 能直接最佳化下游決策並嚴格保留預算與放空限制，可嘗試應用於實際的資產配置流程中。
summary.caveats: 論文未提供具體的報酬與風險數值改善幅度。

papers.title: Neural Estimation of Irreversibility in Real and Simulated Limit Order Book Paths
papers.abstract: A path indistinguishable from its own reverse carries no arrow of time, so time irreversibility is a necessary condition for a directed mechanism to be readable from trajectories alone. In finance it has been measured only on scalar series such as returns and volatility. We define the irreversibility rate of a coarse-grained limit order book path as the forward-to-reverse log-density ratio per event, and estimate it from three weeks of Nasdaq market-by-order data with an order-invariant MLP and a temporal convolutional network that receive identical blocks. For NVDA, the order-invariant and order-sensitive estimates are 0.036 and 0.054 nats per event, respectively. Their difference, the ordering increment, is 0.018. A surrogate preserving the coarse one-step transition table recovers 30 percent less irreversibility than the observed paths. The increment is positive for all twelve symbols on every held-out daytime date, and for NVDA in each session window. It changes more than tenfold with the coarse-graining scale. Neither a linear score nor any single feature group reproduces the full fitted rate. A queue-reactive simulator calibrated on the same days matches the market's ordered rate, 0.052 against 0.054, yet its ordering increment is 0.0006 against 0.018, building temporal asymmetry out of block composition instead of block order. We propose the ordering and scale profile of path irreversibility as a benchmark for order book simulators. Code and audit materials are available at https://github.com/hjyeo30/lob-irreversibility.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF 2026). 9 pages, 5 figures
papers.relevance_reason: 評估訂單簿時間不可逆性，ICAIF口頭發表

summary.title_zh: 真實與模擬限價單簿路徑中不可逆性的神經網路估計
summary.verdict: 提出以神經網路估計限價單簿的時間不可逆性速率，並以此作為檢驗造市模擬器真實性的基準。
summary.problem: 金融領域過去僅在報酬率與波動度等純量序列上測量時間不可逆性，缺乏對限價單簿動態路徑不可逆性的研究。
summary.method: 使用訂單不變量多層感知機與時間卷積網路，分析三週那斯達克逐筆市場資料中的粗粒化限價單簿路徑。
summary.findings: NVDA 的訂單不變量與訂單敏感估計值分別為每事件 0.036 與 0.054 納特，其差值即排序增量為 0.018。排隊反應模擬器雖能吻合整體有序速率，但其排序增量僅有 0.0006。
summary.implication: 可用此方法的排序與尺度分佈作為限價單簿模擬器的檢驗基準，評估模擬器是否能真實反映市場微結構的時間不對稱性。
summary.caveats: 不可逆性速率對粗粒化尺度非常敏感，尺度改變會導致數值發生十倍以上的變化。
